paper_type: STAR Protocols method paper; the transcriptome data come from the companion study Ezagouri et al. 2019 (S1.1.p2, S7.3.p2). No DE analysis, method, threshold or DEG count is reported in this article.
primary_estimand: Effect of a moderate-intensity treadmill run versus the sedentary (basal) condition on gastrocnemius gene expression, evaluated separately at the two active-phase times of day the protocol compares, ZT14 (early) and ZT22 (late) (S3.3.p2, S4.p1, FIG4).
inclusion: C57BL/6J males, 3 months old, gastrocnemius (S4.p1, S3.3; GEO source_name). All 18 deposited samples are used; the High intensity arm is outside this protocol's scope (moderate intensity only, S3.p1) and is analysed as exploratory.
planned_contrasts: Moderate run vs Basal (sedentary) at ZT14 (S3.3.p2 running vs sedentary; S4.p1 ZT14; paper: no DEG count reported)
Moderate run vs Basal (sedentary) at ZT22 (S3.3.p2; S4.p1 ZT22; paper: no DEG count reported)
repeated_measure_unit: none: one muscle per mouse, independent animals
paper_method: not stated (protocol paper, no DE analysis)
paper_results: none for gene expression; only running capacity and blood glucose (S4.p1, FIG4)
